segments.text: Hello and welcome to this massive open online course an introduction to bio risk management.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎学习这门大规模开放在线课程“生物风险管理导论”。

segments.text: I am your instructor Kenneth and in this short segment I will be discussing the structure
segments.zh: 我是你们的讲师 Kenneth，在这一小段中，我将讨论生物安全实验室的

segments.text: and organization of a biosafety laboratory.
segments.zh: 结构和组织。

segments.text: Now most biosafety laboratories are governed by a specific institutional biosafety committee.
segments.zh: 大多数生物安全实验室都由专门的机构生物安全委员会管理。

segments.text: This institutional biosafety committee is responsible for developing the policies for that specific
segments.zh: 机构生物安全委员会负责为该特定设施

segments.text: facility.
segments.zh: 制定政策。

segments.text: The biosafety committee is in turn supported by the facility managers, the biosafety officers
segments.zh: 生物安全委员会又得到设施管理人员、生物安全官

segments.text: and other departments which may be relevant to the functioning and operation of that facility.
segments.zh: 以及与该设施运作和运行相关的其他部门的支持。

segments.text: Let's see how this process begins.
segments.zh: 我们来看看这个过程是如何开始的。

segments.text: So when deciding to set up a biosafety laboratory, one needs to take into account the cost of
segments.zh: 在决定建设生物安全实验室时，需要考虑

segments.text: the facility.
segments.zh: 设施的成本。

segments.text: Operating biosafety facilities involves a significant amount of expenditure in setting
segments.zh: 运营生物安全设施，无论是建设

segments.text: up as well as in operation of the facility.
segments.zh: 还是日常运行，都需要大量开支。

segments.text: Now in this slide I am going to show you how the organizational structure looks in general.
segments.zh: 在这张幻灯片中，我将向大家展示组织结构的一般形式。

segments.text: So at the top of this slide we have the IBC, Institutional Biosafety Committee which comprises
segments.zh: 在幻灯片的最上方是 IBC，也就是机构生物安全委员会，它由

segments.text: the administrators as well as technical experts.
segments.zh: 行政管理人员和技术专家组成。

segments.text: These in turn supervise the operation of the facility via the facility manager.
segments.zh: 他们再通过设施经理来监督设施的运行。

segments.text: The facility manager should essentially be a qualified engineer who is aware of the operation
segments.zh: 设施经理基本上应该是一名合格的工程师，了解设施的

segments.text: of the facility.
segments.zh: 运行情况。

segments.text: The facility manager operates the facility as well as engages in routine maintenance
segments.zh: 设施经理负责运行设施，并视情况进行日常维护

segments.text: and emergency maintenance as the case may be.
segments.zh: 和紧急维修。

segments.text: It is important that he or she be aware of the biosafety procedures even though they may
segments.zh: 重要的是，即使他或她可能是工程背景出身，

segments.text: be from an engineering background.
segments.zh: 也要了解生物安全程序。

segments.text: The second most important pivot in this management structure is the science officer
segments.zh: 这一管理结构中第二重要的支柱，是科学官，

segments.text: or the biosafety officer.
segments.zh: 也就是生物安全官。

segments.text: The biosafety officers are specifically trained in the management of the facility in terms
segments.zh: 生物安全官在设施管理方面接受过专门培训，包括

segments.text: of the risk assessment, risk mitigation and performance assessment.
segments.zh: 风险评估、风险缓解和绩效评估。

segments.text: They are critical to the operation of the facility and they should be given the authority
segments.zh: 他们对设施的运行至关重要，应该赋予他们权力，

segments.text: to flag any breaches of containment or any violations in procedures.
segments.zh: 对任何防护失效或违反程序的行为提出警示。

segments.text: Now a biosafety officer essentially facilitates the operation of the facility.
segments.zh: 生物安全官基本上是为设施的运行提供保障。

segments.text: He or she cannot be expected to develop specific policies for management of certain risk groups
segments.zh: 不能指望他或她来制定管理某些风险等级组

segments.text: or risk agents.
segments.zh: 或风险因子的具体政策。

segments.text: This is the responsibility of the principal officer or the principal investigator.
segments.zh: 这是主要负责人，也就是项目负责人的职责。

segments.text: The principal investigator is the individual who will conduct experiments and procedures
segments.zh: 项目负责人是在设施中开展实验

segments.text: at the facility.
segments.zh: 和操作的人。

segments.text: So here we have the basic structure, the institutional biosafety committee supposing
segments.zh: 这就是基本结构：机构生物安全委员会监督

segments.text: the overall functioning of the laboratory, the facility manager who looks after the mechanical
segments.zh: 实验室的整体运作，设施经理负责设施的机械

segments.text: operation of the facility, the biosafety officer who looks after the risk assessment,
segments.zh: 运行，生物安全官负责风险评估、

segments.text: risk mitigation and performance assessment, and the principal investigator who is responsible
segments.zh: 风险缓解和绩效评估，而项目负责人则负责

segments.text: for the actual experiments itself.
segments.zh: 实际的实验本身。

segments.text: Now all of these three components function below the IBC and they need to work in synchronicity
segments.zh: 这三个组成部分都在 IBC 之下运作，它们需要彼此

segments.text: with each other.
segments.zh: 协调一致。

segments.text: And what needs to be understood is that in the facility itself, the biosafety officer
segments.zh: 需要明白的是，在设施内部，生物安全官

segments.text: is the one who has the authority to oversee operations.
segments.zh: 是有权监督各项操作的人。

segments.text: Thinking about this structure, I move on now into the policy itself.
segments.zh: 了解了这个结构，我现在来谈谈政策本身。

segments.text: It is very important that every biosafety facility has a specific biosafety policy which
segments.zh: 非常重要的是，每个生物安全设施都要有一份具体的生物安全政策，

segments.text: indicates the commitment of the organization to both biosafety and biosecurity at that
segments.zh: 表明机构对该设施生物安全和生物安保两方面的

segments.text: respective facility.
segments.zh: 承诺。

segments.text: Biosafety policy in itself has to be written so it has to be specific, measurable, achievable,
segments.zh: 生物安全政策本身必须以书面形式制定，而且必须是具体的、可衡量的、可实现的、

segments.text: realistic, and time-based.
segments.zh: 现实的和有时限的。

segments.text: So this policy will govern the next instrument which is the biosafety manual.
segments.zh: 这项政策将规范下一个工具，也就是生物安全手册。

segments.text: Biosafety manuals are specific to a facility and biosafety manuals are basically written
segments.zh: 生物安全手册是针对特定设施的，基本上是

segments.text: based on specific guidelines.
segments.zh: 根据特定的指南编写的。

segments.text: So for instance, at our facility, we use the WHO guidelines, the BMBL guidelines, as well
segments.zh: 例如，在我们的设施中，我们采用世卫组织的指南、BMBL 指南，以及

segments.text: as guidelines from the NIH, and any local agency.
segments.zh: NIH 的指南和任何地方机构的指南。

segments.text: In our case, we use CIRAM standards.
segments.zh: 在我们这里，我们采用 SIRIM 标准。

segments.text: In your particular location, you may have to use specific standards based on your national
segments.zh: 在你所在的地方，你可能需要根据本国

segments.text: or state requirements.
segments.zh: 或本州的要求采用特定的标准。

segments.text: That is basically how the structure of a biosafety facility is set up.
segments.zh: 这基本上就是生物安全设施组织结构的设置方式。

segments.text: You have an administration and you have the officers who execute the basic functions.
segments.zh: 有一个管理层，还有执行基本职能的各类负责人员。

segments.text: Now having said that, one comes down to the aspect of cost.
segments.zh: 说完这些，就要谈到成本问题。

segments.text: The cost of a facility has two components, the operational cost as well as the cost
segments.zh: 设施的成本包括两部分：运行成本和

segments.text: of establishment.
segments.zh: 建设成本。

segments.text: Establishment cost can be quite high and the operational costs basically add to the operating
segments.zh: 建设成本可能相当高，而运行成本基本上会计入

segments.text: cost for every experiment that is conducted at the facility.
segments.zh: 在设施中开展的每一项实验的运行费用。

segments.text: When designing the facility, please ensure that you have designed it, taking into consideration
segments.zh: 在设计设施时，请务必在设计中考虑到

segments.text: the cost of maintenance because setting up a facility is one thing, but operating it
segments.zh: 维护成本，因为建一个设施是一回事，而运行它

segments.text: is another thing.
segments.zh: 又是另一回事。

segments.text: This is a short segment which I have developed for you in order to explain informally the
segments.zh: 这是我为大家制作的一小段视频，用来非正式地讲解

segments.text: process of facility management.
segments.zh: 设施管理的过程。

segments.text: You can refer to my lecture notes which will describe what I have stated in detail.
segments.zh: 大家可以参考我的讲义，其中会详细介绍我所讲的内容。

segments.text: Thank you very much for watching this segment and please stay biosafe.
segments.zh: 非常感谢观看这一段视频，请注意生物安全。
